introduction_markdown: CAMEROON GENERAL CERTIFICATE OF EDUCATION BOARD, General Certificate of Education Examination, June 2020, Ordinary Level, Additional Mathematics, Paper 2 (0575). Time allowed: two and a half hours. Answer ALL QUESTIONS IN SECTION A and ANY TWO QUESTIONS FROM EITHER SECTION B or SECTION C. IN SECTIONS B AND C, ALL QUESTIONS CARRY EQUAL MARKS. Candidates are expected to answer a combination of Section A and Section B OR Section A and Section C but NOT a combination of all three. Section A: Pure Mathematics (compulsory, answer all questions). Section B: Mechanics (if this section is chosen, then Section C may not be chosen; answer any two questions). Section C: Statistics and Probability (if this section is chosen, then Section B may not be chosen; answer any two questions). All necessary working must be shown. No marks will be awarded for answers without brief statements showing how the answers have been obtained. Electronic calculators may be used. Where necessary take g as 10 m s^-2. Formulae Booklets may be used.

questions.enonce_markdown:
(i) A discrete random variable, $X$, has probability mass function, $p$, defined by

$$p(x)=\begin{cases}k(x-1), & \text{for } x=1,2,3,4\\ 0, & \text{elsewhere}\end{cases}$$

where, $k$, is a constant.

(a) Copy and complete the distribution table. *[2 marks]*

| $x$ | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| $P(X=x)$ | 0 |   | $2k$ |   |

Find:

(b) the value of the constant $k$. *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
The probabilities add up to $1$:

$$0+k+2k+3k=1\ \Longrightarrow\ 6k=1\ \Longrightarrow\ k=\frac16.$$

**$k=\dfrac16$.** The distribution is $P(X=2)=\frac16$, $P(X=3)=\frac13$, $P(X=4)=\frac12$.

questions.enonce_markdown: (c) the mean and variance of $X$. *[5 marks]*

(ii) In a basket of mangoes, one out of every two mangoes is rotten. Five mangoes are drawn at random from the basket one after the other. Using the binomial distribution or otherwise, find the probability that:

(a) all the mangoes chosen are rotten, *[3 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Let $Y$ be the number of rotten mangoes among the $5$ drawn: $Y\sim B(5,\tfrac12)$ (each mango is rotten with probability $p=\frac12$, independently), so $P(Y=r)=\binom5r\left(\frac12\right)^5$.

$$P(Y=5)=\binom55\left(\tfrac12\right)^5=\frac1{32}.$$

**The probability that all five are rotten is $\dfrac1{32}\approx0.031$.**

questions.enonce_markdown: (b) less than two mangoes are rotten. *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Less than two rotten means $Y=0$ or $Y=1$:

$$P(Y<2)=P(Y=0)+P(Y=1)=\binom50\left(\tfrac12\right)^5+\binom51\left(\tfrac12\right)^5=\frac{1+5}{32}=\frac{6}{32}=\frac{3}{16}.$$

**The probability is $\dfrac3{16}=0.1875$.**

questions.enonce_markdown: (c) Find the mean and variance of the distribution. *[3 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
For a binomial distribution $B(n,p)$: mean $=np$ and variance $=npq$ with $q=1-p$. Here $n=5$, $p=\frac12$, $q=\frac12$:

$$\text{mean}=5\times\tfrac12=2.5,\qquad\text{variance}=5\times\tfrac12\times\tfrac12=1.25.$$

**Mean $=2.5$ and variance $=1.25$.**
